translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Fioang Awewen Rhooan Neginegin Maan
Jesus a iura pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi minna wenewenen: mwaaen na ese toonong me noan aesemaen gurun sheep we pwe etonong me eew pwiuneoi, nge iiy erhai maan mwoarho me esooaw piraf.
Aeremas na etonong me noan aesemaen gurun sheep we nge ina rhooan neginegin sheep kkewe.
Rhooan poosun guruwe epwe sugi ngaeni asam, nge iir sheep kkewe repwe rongorong mwaeniaen igine epwe faingi iteer nge a wummwuur wow niugiun.
Igiwe a paeniir wow, nge ina epwe gommw memmweer, nge sheep kkewe ra tapweei mwirin pwe iga ra aeginna mwaenian.
Esooar erhai ne repwe tapweei; pwe repwe faer fattapw saengi aeremas we, pwe iga rese aeginna ttigin mwaenian.”
Jesus a fioangei ngaeniir fioangon awewe eei, nge iir rese metefaaegini faan.
Jesus Minne Erhai Rhooan Negineg Kkewe e Mwamwaai
Jesus a pwan aengaeniir pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi minna wenewenen, pwe ngaang minne aesemeer sheep kkewe.
Oanongeer rhooa kkewe regommwoto me mmwaei nge iir maan mwoarho me soaw piraf, pwe sheep kkewe rese rongorong mwaenieer.
Ngaang minne asam. Iyo kka re itto toonong me reei nge repwe menaw; repwe itto toonong nge retowow nge repwe rhurhu mwongo.
Maan mwoarho we ina e itto rhag pwe epwe mwoarho me nni me oatoaropa. Ngaang itto pwe aegin oawpwe menaw — ina menaw na oarosaen mwamwaai.
“Ngaang rhooan neginegin sheep kkewe e mwamwaai, iwe i mwerhaen mae noa faaen iteer sheep kkewe.

Mwaaen we refang paniuwan pwe rhooai neginegiir sheep kkewe, nge iir sheep kkewe nge saapw pwan naiun. Epwe weri rhag itton erhai wolf nge epwe fattapw saengiir sheep kkewe; iwe wolf we a itto niir nge re peraseras noa.
Mwaaen we refang rhag paniuwaen pwe rhooan neginegin sheep kkewe, ina e fattapw noa pwe iga ese tepaar sheep kkewe pwe saapw naiun.

Ngaang rhooan neginegin sheep kkewe e mwamwaai. Mwaaen na Semaei e giuneaei nge ngaang i giuneei mwaaen na Semaei, ina epwan ina wusun pwe ngaang i giuneer naeyi sheep nge sheep kka naeyi repwan giuneaei. Ngaang ipwe fangenoa menewaei faaen iteer.
Epwan no aekkaerhai sheep ikka naeyi iga re soano noan guru eei. Ipwan pwigiir to, nge iir repwe rongorong mwaeniaei nge ra itto no pwe eew cchon sheep, nge erhai rhag rhooai neginegiir.
“Mwaaen na Semaei e aerhaengiaei pwe iga i mwerhaen fangenoa menewaei, pwe ipwe mmwenen pwan pwigi sefaaeniy.

Esooar ne epwe pwigi saengiaei menewaei. Ngaang minne ipwe sipegin fangenoa. Eyor maemaewaei aaei ipwe sipegin fangenoa, nge eyor maemaewaei aaei ipwe pwan pwigi sefaaeniy. Ieei minne mwaaen na Semaei e ammwir ngaeniaei pwe ipwe feeori.”
Iwe a pwan yor ginigin nepeteer aeremas pwe reen kkepas kkeei.
E towunap rhooakka re iura pwe, “Eyor mwuniaan wooan! A mmang noa! Meeta oaw rhiuwen aiussaening ngaeni reen?”
Nge aekkaaemweoi re iura pwe, “Mwaaen eyor mwuniaan wooan nge ese mmwen epwe ieen wusun mwaenian! Epwe ifa wusun aaen mwuniaan aeffeta noa meseer rhooa parh?”
Aar Oapwuta Jesus
A oaton nefaeng, nge a toori oaton gupwunon oatonongon Temple we me Jerusalem.
Jesus e faaeraeg fetaen faaen pweranta we regaen iura pwe Pwerantaen Solomon me reen Temple we,
iwe aeremas ra maegeto reen ra aeiineow pwe, “Epwe ifa ssiunaein oamw aeppaeti fetaenegemaem? Aengaenigemaem minna wenewenen: aere een minne Kristus?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Ngaang iya fasiun aengaenigaemi, nge aaemi oawse niugiuniug ngaeniaei. Minikka igaen feeori reen maemaewaen minna Semaei ina egaen pwaeritae mmwenei;
nge aaemi oawse niugiuniug, pwe iga aaemi saapw aaemi naeyi sheep.
Sheep kka naeyi re aiussaening ngaeni minikka mwaeniaei; ngaang i giuneer nge iir re tapweaei.
I ngaenneer menaw na esooar ssiaaenin nge esooar faaen eew ne repwe mae. Esooar erhai ne epwe mmwenen torofiir saengiaei.
Meeta na manna Semaei e ngaenneaei, ina e taegias saengi oanongaen aegiaeg, nge esooar erhai ne emmwenen epwe torofiir noa me noan paiun manna Semaei.
Manna Semaei me ngaang nge aei eew rhag.”
Iwe rhag nge aeremas ra pwan pweipwog faai pwe repwe tera.

Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “E igin ssow min mwamwaai kka i itto feeori me weni mmwaemi iga manna Semaei efang ngaeniaei pwe ipwe feeori; ifa me neeiin minikkaan minne oaw tipaeni pwe oawpwe terayaei reen?”
Ra iura pwe, “Aeise mwerhaen aeipwe teroag reen mini mwamwaai kka wofeeori, pwe faer reen oamw fioang aenneewa Deus! Een rhag erhai aeremas nge wa itto feeoriug noa pwe een Deus!”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Effoat noan oasoapwosoapw we aaemi pwe Deus e iura pwe, ‘Aaemi minikka deus.’
Si giuneei pwe minna Pwapwior we e Santus e iura nge ennet nge esooar iaenin; iwe Deus e faingiir aeremas kenaan pwe iir deus, aeremas kenaan nge ikkina aeremas kkewe efang mwaenian ngaeniir.
Iwe nge ngaang, manna Semaei minne e finiaei iwe a fangeto ngaang noan faeinaengiy. Iwe epwe ifa wusun rhag oawwa mmwenen iura pwe i fioang aenneewa Deus iga iura pwe ngaang Naiun Deus?
Aere ise feeorin minikkena minna Semaei e mwerhaen ipwe feeori, iwe ina nge oawsoapw niugiuniug ngaeniaei.

Nge aere ifeeorin, nge inamwo oawse niugiuniug ngaeniaei, ina nge engaang kka aaei mwo nge oawpwe niugiuniug ngaeni, pwe aegin oawpwe giuneei gacchiuw pwe minna Semaei eno reei nge ino reen minna Semaei.”
Ra pwan aegina aar repwe torofi Jesus, nge ennus noa me noan paiiur.
Jesus a pwan sefaaen noa noan pwupwu we Jordan, pwiuneoi we e paptismus John me ee, iwe a noa no ee.
Re towunap aeremas ra itto reen, ra iura pwe, “John esooar aeginn ne egaen feeori, iwe oanongaen minikka e aepesa pwe kkepesaen mwaaen een nge ennet.”
Iwe re towunap aeremas kkewe reno igiwe ra niugiuniug ngaeni.
